$Comment: The game's own Wooden Earth Wand, on Orrin's shelf. No recipe, drop or chest hands a player a wand, and the Every Blade achievement wants one unmade at a Disenchanting Table, so this is where it comes from. Priced in Essence of Life taken from the bag, what Orrin's own tithes ask for, and kept above the most one unmaking gives back, so buying a wand and unmaking it never makes essence. No Limits: a player may buy as many as they can pay for. The title is the item's own name key, written in full (server.items.<Id>.name), so the shelf shows the name the bag shows; the item has no description key, so the offer has no line under it. The filename is the offer id, and each player's purchase count is filed under it.
